briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over autonomous agents. Regulatory pressure grows in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced multi-step reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro launched last week. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays. Microsoft and xAI announce new 100k H100 cluster expansions in Texas and Memphis.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems achieve reliable self-improvement loops before 2028?
